feeds.title: Bar None BBQ Blog
feeds.description: Bar None Barbecue is a full-service San Diego caterer that brings our custom chuckwagon on location to your event - cooking over a live wood fire while providing impeccable service, professional presentation, and delicious food! Whether you're planning a corporate luncheon in Sorrento Valley, a company picnic on Mission Bay, a birthday party in Chula Vista, or a family reunion in El Cajon, let Bar None Barbecue's score of event planning experience guide you so that every detail is considered.

feeds.title: Rotisserie Affair Catering Blog
feeds.description: For 35 years, Rotisserie Affair has been a premier choice for special event catering across Southern California. Their expertise extends beyond traditional services, earning them distinction for unique 'cooked on-site' rotisseries. Renowned for its culinary innovation, it seamlessly blends tradition with a touch of flair, offering clients an unforgettable experience. Their commitment to excellence has solidified their reputation as a go-to catering service, combining culinary expertise and a unique on-site cooking approach that sets them apart in the Southern California catering landscape.
